rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable braking-zone definition where the dangerous-zone boundary was previously unspecified. This directly alters the distance/spatial-information basis used by H1-ORR3, which preserves whether the ego-object spatial relation requires braking. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged, but the revalidation condition H1-RC3 is triggered because the distance or spatial-information requirement and dangerous-zone definition changed.
